issuing_body: Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI)
covered_actors: Business users of AI-related services (ユーザ)
In-house legal departments and outside counsel (社内法務部・顧問弁護士等)
Business department personnel (ビジネス部門担当者等)
implementation_notes: Non-binding practical contract checklist published by METI in February 2025 to address the rapid adoption of generative AI and foundation models following the 2019 Contract Guidelines on Utilization of AI and Data. It outlines contractual checkpoints for usage-type and development-type contracts across three use cases (general-purpose AI services, customized services, and new development), covering input/output definitions, intellectual property attribution, security practices (architecture review, SBOM, audit clauses, log retention), terms-of-service updates under the Civil Code, and personal data / cross-border transfer compliance under Articles 27 and 28 of Japan's Act on the Protection of Personal Information (APPI).
